theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_measure_le_add
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X Y Z : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (RX RY RZ : IMRep U n) (c : ℝ), IsOpen U → |c| ≤ 1 → RX.Represents X → RY.Represents Y → RZ.Represents Z → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Z ω = X ω + c * Y ω) → RZ.measure ≤ RX.measure + RY.measure
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
